reference: Right now he is holding a blue ice pack against the lump.
sk: Práve teraz tlačí modrý obklad na hrču.
cz: Právě teď tlačí modrý obklad na bouli.
acceptable: {Right now|At the moment} he is {holding|pressing} a blue {ice pack|cold compress|compress} {against|to|on} the {lump|bump}.
He is {holding|pressing} a blue {ice pack|cold compress|compress} {against|to|on} the {lump|bump} {right now|at the moment}.

mistakes.text: {Right now|At the moment} he holds a blue ice pack against the lump.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej prebieha práve teraz, preto Present Continuous: „he is holding“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj probíhá právě teď, proto Present Continuous: „he is holding“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action is happening now, so use Present Continuous: “he is holding”.

mistakes.text: {Right now|At the moment} he is hold a blue ice pack against the lump.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Present Continuous tvorí „is“ + sloveso s „-ing“: „is holding“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Present Continuous se tvoří z „is“ + slovesa s „-ing“: „is holding“.

mistakes.text: {Right now|At the moment} he holding a blue ice pack against the lump.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Present Continuous potrebuje pomocné sloveso: „he is holding“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Present Continuous potřebuje pomocné sloveso: „he is holding“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Present Continuous needs the helping verb “is”: “he is holding”.

mistakes.text: {Right now|At the moment} he is {holding|pressing} blue ice pack against the lump.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred počítateľným podstatným menom v jednotnom čísle chýba člen: „a blue ice pack“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Před počitatelným podstatným jménem v jednotném čísle chybí člen: „a blue ice pack“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A singular countable noun needs an article: “a blue ice pack”.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'tlačí modrý obklad' (is pressing a blue compress), with no 'ice'; pressing/compress accepted.
